messages:
marta: Heads-up - Aurora pilot hitting lots of 429s during warmup. Customer running scripted load for tomorrow's demos and seeing intermittent throttles. Sam (customer) posted logs in the ticket.
sam: posting example: 
`2026-03-22T08:10:02Z WARN rate_limiter: rejected request, quota_exceeded user_id=aurora-team trace=xyz`

dan: which route and token tier? are they hitting policy per-user limits or global account limit?
marta: /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. They requested 10k qps warmup traffic but are on trial with default quota. They asked for temporary higher throughput yesterday but we didn't fully provision dedicated lanes.
tom: if it's quota we can temporarily bump their rate limit via policy override or spin up a dedicated pool. Quickest is to add a policy override for the account with a timebox. That requires authz change + config reload.
claire: security checklist: if we spin dedicated capacity we need to confirm data residency and that the customer agreed to host in shared infra. Also update SSQ that we provided ephemeral quota changes.
nina: pricing question: are these support hours and dedicated capacity chargeable as a one-off add-on? SalesOps needs to know to amend PO.
marta: yes please flag as billable. They signed a PO for standard pilot; extra infra/support should be on a separate SOW.
dan: I can apply a policy override now for preprod and prod but need an approval from sales lead. marta, can you confirm?
marta: approve for immediate mitigation. I'll log the add-on and notify the customer.
ops-bot: policy override request received for account aurora-325 - pending approver marta

dan: applying override to preprod first. will monitor error rate and latency. Tom, can you watch the runtime for queue buildup?
tom: watching. turning on per-request tracing and queue-length alert. deploy-bot: scaleup job queued - requested by dan - adding 2x inference workers to preprod-gpu pool

dan: preprod override in place, sending curl test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://preprod.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'`

sam: tests look much better now, 200s for 100 concurrent. But customer worried about flapping tomorrow when external load increases.
tom: plan for tomorrow: 1) keep override for 24h with automatic rollback, 2) enable autoscale buffer + soft-fallback to smaller model if queue > 80% for >30s, 3) add synthetic healthchecks from their IPs. I'll open the runtime playbook PR.

marta: timeline and handoffs: dan -> keep override active and watch; tom -> add fallback rule and tests; nina -> update PO and pricing add-on; claire -> update SSQ entry; marta -> confirm with customer and send escalation note to exec sponsor.
nina: pinging SalesOps for quote - will prepare invoice addendum for dedicated warmup + after-hours support.
claire: SSQ entry: noted temporary quota bump and data residency confirmation required. will update doc and send to customer security contact.

dan: monitoring graphs show 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 1.2% after override. I'll keep a 1m digested metric live.
sam: thanks team - customer is relieved. They'll run staged load tomorrow at 09:00 PST.
marta: keep channel updates here. If anything spikes, tag me and I'll call the customer. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

messages_summary: short-lived policy override mitigated 429s during warmup; action items created for billing, SSQ, autoscale/fallback, and a 24h rollback window.
